hypothesis: Collapsing the 3-step checkout into a single page will reduce friction enough to lift conversion, because funnel analysis shows 40% of drop-off happens between steps 2 and 3.
name: One-page checkout redesign

hypothesis: Leading with the annual plan (instead of monthly) on the pricing page will shift plan mix toward annual, because annual buyers currently discover the option only after selecting monthly.
name: Pricing page A/B: annual-first

hypothesis: Replacing the 7-screen tutorial with a 3-step interactive flow will raise completion and early retention, because session replays show users dropping off at screen 4.
name: Mobile onboarding: 3-step flow
